div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 1px; height: 1px; padding-top: 24px; margin-left: 19px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #1f2933;
display: inline-block; font-size: 20px; font-family: 'Courier New'; color: light-dark(#1f2933, #c4ccd5); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: nowrap;

div.div:
1: `default_nettype none
2:
3: module top (
4: input wire clk,
5: output wire [5:0] led_output
6: );
7:
8: logic [5:0] led = 'd0;
9: logic overflow;
10:
11: assign led_output = ~led;
12:
13: always_ff @ (posedge clk) begin
14: if (overflow) begin
15: led <= led + 'd1;
16: end
17: end
18:
19: timer #(
20: .COUNT_MAX (13500000)
21: ) inst_0 (
22: .clk (clk),
23: .overflow (overflow)
24: );
25:
26: endmodule

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 1px; height: 1px; padding-top: 24px; margin-left: 719px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #1f2933;
display: inline-block; font-size: 20px; font-family: 'Courier New'; color: light-dark(#1f2933, #c4ccd5); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: nowrap;

div.div:
27:
28: module timer #(
29: parameter COUNT_MAX = 27000000
30: ) (
31: input wire clk,
32: output logic overflow
33: );
34:
35: logic [$clog2(COUNT_MAX)-1:0] counter = 'd0; // 0 〜 COUNT_MAX-1 を数える
36:
37: always_ff @ (posedge clk) begin
38: if (counter == COUNT_MAX - 1) begin
39: counter <= 'd0;
40: overflow <= 'd1;
41: end else begin
42: counter <= counter + 'd1;
43: overflow <= 'd0;
44: end
45: end
46:
47: endmodule
48:
49: `default_nettype wire
